sub: Conquer the World, One Roll at a Time
needTwo: Needs at least 2 soldiers to attack.
notAdj: Not adjacent to the selected territory.
badSave: Saved game is invalid or outdated and was discarded.
aboutT: Dice Conquest: an original offline turn-based dice strategy game. Single-file build of the core game. Map imagery: NASA Blue Marble (public domain).
howT:
1. Pick your territory with 2+ soldiers.
2. Pick an adjacent enemy territory (linked by a line).
3. Each side rolls one D6 per soldier. Attacker wins only if its total is strictly greater (ties go to the defender).
4. After the battle the source keeps exactly 1 soldier. If you win, all other soldiers move into the conquered territory; if you lose, they are lost.
5. When you end your turn you get dice equal to half of your frontier (links to enemy territories, rounded up, min 1) and place them on any of your territories (max 8 each).
6. Last player standing wins. Auto-play lets the AI play for you; Online lets friends join with a room code.
7. Owning a whole continent gives bonus dice (see the side panel). Shortcuts: Enter = end turn, Esc = deselect, + / − = zoom, A = auto-play. Click the battle history to expand it.
8. Alliances: pick Teams in setup, or press 🤝 next to a player (AI or local human) to propose one. Allies cannot attack each other, see no border with each other, and win together. ✂ breaks the alliance.
isAlly: This territory belongs to an ally.
dupColor: Colors swapped so every player stays distinct.
quitQ: Leave the game? Progress is saved.
